summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, building computer vision for robot manipulation: TensorRT-optimized YOLO object detection driving visual servoing on a physical pick-and-place arm (92 FPS, 10/10 picks). Background in geometric vision and depth estimation (homography stitching, ZoeDepth 3D surface reconstruction at ±8% error) and in building reproducible datasets and evaluations in Python and C++.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline for high-resolution generation using bit manipulation and averaging, achieving a PSNR of 65 compared to homography-based stitching baseline.
Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API to fine-tune DONUT on a custom medical billing dataset.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system on a Jetson+Arduino controller; TensorRT-optimized YOLO object detection (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) drives visual servoing, with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Built a LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Built a PySide6/Qt desktop GUI with an OpenGL-backed VisPy 3D viewport to visualize coordinate-frame hierarchies, parent-child transform chains, and SE(3) poses in real time.

Wrote a custom DSL parser and SE(3) math engine (math_se3.py) supporting local/world rotation and translation composition, recursive world-transform chaining, and live 4x4 matrix inspection per frame.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
